previous_statement: The ledger hypotheses give W.K3>=W.L and W.K3>=c0*W.L. Also W.L>=L^0>=1 and c0>=1, hence c0<=c0*W.L<=W.K3. Multiplication by epsilon>=0 yields W.L*epsilon<=t_3, c0*epsilon<=t_3, and c0*W.L*epsilon<=t_3.
new_statement: The ledger hypotheses give W.K3>=W.L and W.K3>=c0*W.L, while W.L>=L^0>=1. The supplied near-unit hypothesis for w and nonnegativity of the norm give 0<=||w(I_{C^m})-I_A||<=W.c0_cb*epsilon=c0*epsilon. Thus c0*epsilon is nonnegative, so W.L>=1 implies c0*epsilon<=c0*W.L*epsilon. Separately, multiplication of W.K3>=W.L and W.K3>=c0*W.L by epsilon>=0 gives W.L*epsilon<=t_3 and c0*W.L*epsilon<=t_3. Hence also c0*epsilon<=t_3, establishing all three coefficient inequalities without assuming c0>=1.
